dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-alpine-nginx:3.24

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG BABYBUDDY_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

ENV S6_STAGE2_HOOK="/init-hook"

RUN \
  echo "**** install build packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache --virtual=build-dependencies \
    build-base \
    jpeg-dev \
    libffi-dev \
    libxml2-dev \
    libxslt-dev \
    mariadb-dev \
    postgresql-dev \
    python3-dev \
    zlib-dev && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    jpeg \
    libffi \
    libpq \
    libxml2 \
    libxslt \
    mariadb-connector-c \
    python3 && \
  echo "**** install babybuddy ****" && \
  if [ -z ${BABYBUDDY_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    BABYBUDDY_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/babybuddy/babybuddy/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/babybuddy.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/archive/refs/tags/${BABYBUDDY_VERSION}.tar.gz" && \
  mkdir -p /app/www/public && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/babybuddy.tar.gz -C \
    /app/www/public --strip-components=1 && \
  cd /app/www/public && \
  python3 -m venv /lsiopy && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir \
    pip \
    setuptools && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.24/ \
    -r requirements.txt && \
  pip install -U --no-cache-dir --find-links https://wheel-index.linuxserver.io/alpine-3.24/ \
    mysqlclient && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apk del --purge \
    build-dependencies && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    $HOME/.cache \
    $HOME/.cargo

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 8000
VOLUME /config

units.name: init-babybuddy-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

mkdir -p /config/{data,media}
rm -rf /app/www/public/{data,media}
ln -s /config/data /app/www/public/data
ln -s /config/media /app/www/public/media

cd /app/www/public || exit 1

if [[ ! -f "/config/.secretkey" ]]; then
    echo "**** No secret key found, generating one ****"
    python3 manage.py shell -c 'from django.core.management import utils; print(utils.get_random_secret_key())' |
        tr -d '\n' >/config/.secretkey
fi

export \
    DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE="babybuddy.settings.base" \
    ALLOWED_HOSTS="${ALLOWED_HOSTS:-*}" \
    TIME_ZONE="${TZ:-UTC}" \
    DEBUG="${DEBUG:-False}" \
    SECRET_KEY="${SECRET_KEY:-$(cat /config/.secretkey)}"
python3 manage.py migrate --noinput
python3 manage.py createcachetable

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /config

units.name: svc-babybuddy
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

export \
    DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE="babybuddy.settings.base" \
    ALLOWED_HOSTS="${ALLOWED_HOSTS:-*}" \
    TIME_ZONE="${TZ:-UTC}" \
    DEBUG="${DEBUG:-False}" \
    SECRET_KEY="${SECRET_KEY:-$(cat /config/.secretkey)}"

exec \
    s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 3000" \
    cd /app/www/public s6-setuidgid abc gunicorn babybuddy.wsgi -b 127.0.0.1:3000 --log-level=info \
    --worker-tmp-dir=/dev/shm --log-file=- \
    --workers=2 --threads=4 --worker-class=gthread

notes.upstream:
### 🚨 Security Fixes
* Fixed a vulnerability reported by @JulienPerrinGithub allowing an attacker can send a `REMOTE-USER` header to impersonate any user on all API endpoints when `REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH=True`.
  * **Impact:** Instances running Baby Buddy version 2.3.0 to 2.10.1 with `REVERSE_PROXY_AUTH=True`. Originally introduced in 2c10fc03a56d9a7cd5e24ea4124646a835c444ce.
  * **Tracking:** A CVE identifier has been requested through GitHub and this section will be updated once assigned. You can monitor the status via the [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/security/advisories/GHSA-3p4x-4w4p-vjj2).


## What's Changed
* fix(core): populate the read-only group on first migrate by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1141
* fix: apply model permissions to reports, the timeline and dashboard cards by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1143
* fix: correct the permission codenames used by head circumference and tags by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1144
* fix: stop the password reset test from logging out the shared client by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1145
* feat(core): add diaper change colors (gray, orange, red, white) + migration by @SoTHISIsFitness in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1083
* Add Recent Notes dashboard card (#1038) by @SoTHISIsFitness in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1114
* feat(l10n): improve Dutch translations by @JurianLock in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1137
* feat(l10n): improve Russian translations by @HKSsss in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1142
* Update to plotly.py to v6 and plotly.js by @Cadair in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1074
* fix: quick-start timer child association not working with more than one child by @cdubz with @Copilot in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1139
* feat: add a scoped caregiver user role by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1134
* fix: empty-state colspan on Notes list (multiple children) by @TianHengZhuang in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1147
* fix: empty-state colspan on list pages (multiple children) by @TianHengZhuang in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1148
* fix(reports): plot solid and wet diaper intervals on the right dates by @NotAFlightRisk in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1150
* chore(deps): bump pillow from 11.3.0 to 12.3.0 in the pip group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1071
* feat: add a notes field to Tummy Time by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1146
* feat: let users complete their own timers by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1156
* feat: add an optional access expiry to user accounts by @Daltonganger in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1157
* feat(core): show the timer name on activity add forms by @superphosphate in https://github.com/babybuddy/babybuddy/pull/1135
